changes: Added a Home Assistant add-on repository wrapper
Added Home Assistant Supervisor MQTT service discovery with manual MQTT fallback options
Added persistent runtime configuration and bilingual option descriptions
Documented add-on installation and network requirements
Reworked the root README around Home Assistant add-on installation
Expanded the add-on store README with MQTT and DNS requirements
Expanded the add-on changelog with feature, ingress, persistence, and security details
Removed the Home Assistant add-on build dependency on the private GHCR package
Changed the add-on Dockerfile to build the public GitHub dev source directly
Added automatic Korean translations for the management panel and device monitor
Kept the Rethink add-on name untranslated
Retained English as the fallback UI language
Promoted the Home Assistant add-on version from 0.1.0-dev to 0.1.1
Changed the add-on source build reference from the mutable dev branch to the released master branch
Updated branch references in the add-on documentation
Fixed exec /run.sh not found failures caused by CRLF shebangs
Added Git attributes for LF-only runtime and build files
Normalized the startup script during the Docker build
Changed the default Rethink hostname from rethink.lan to rethink.home.arpa
Updated add-on and standalone documentation to use the new DNS default
Stopped publishing RAC liquid and gas pipe temperature sensors when the device reports unsupported raw sentinel values 0 or 1
Added regression coverage that preserves valid outdoor-unit temperature sensors
Changed RAC target temperature controls to whole-degree steps
Rounded direct fractional target-temperature commands to the nearest supported whole degree while preserving half-degree current-temperature readings
Added a state-backed Indirect wind toggle for RAC devices
Mapped indirect wind ON to vertical vane value 1 and OFF to value 6 while retaining the existing swing control
Replaced the RAC auto dry diagnostic binary sensor with a state-backed toggle switch
Mapped auto dry ON and OFF commands to verified protocol values while retaining the remaining-progress sensor
Removed the add-on host mapping for internal unencrypted MQTT port 1884 to avoid broker add-on conflicts
Documented that ThinQ 2 requires Rethink host port 8883 and conflicting broker add-on mappings must be removed
Retained rethink.home.arpa as the default configurable hostname
Promoted the Home Assistant add-on version from 0.1.1 to 0.1.2
Added a dedicated 0.1.2 release changelog for RAC controls, sensor handling, and MQTT port conflict changes
Aligned the add-on DOCS with the Korean README and its hostname, required-port, and MQTT broker conflict guidance
Documented ipTIME DHCP and DNS setup for routing appliance queries through AdGuard Home
